title: PolicySet
description: A registered, versioned, and auditable policy ruleset. PolicySets are first-class Registry objects that attribute PolicyDecision verdicts to specific regulatory frameworks and rule versions. The ruleset content (e.g. OPA .rego files) lives outside AGP; the PolicySet record provides the immutable fingerprint, provenance, and lifecycle metadata needed to audit which rules governed any given decision. See §25.

policy_set_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this PolicySet. Immutable after creation.

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'EU AI Act 2024 — High-Risk AI Systems'.

version.description: Semantic version of this ruleset. Increment the minor version for non-breaking rule additions; major version for breaking changes to verdict logic.

publisher.description: Agent or organisation that published and is responsible for maintaining this PolicySet.

regulatory_frameworks.description: The regulatory frameworks this PolicySet implements. A single PolicySet may implement multiple frameworks (e.g. EU_AI_ACT_2024 + EU_GDPR).

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions in which this PolicySet applies. Tasks whose jurisdictions intersect this list must use this PolicySet (or a compatible one) when compliance with the declared regulatory_frameworks is required.

ruleset_hash.description: Content hash of the policy ruleset artifact (e.g. sha256: of the OPA bundle .tar.gz). Allows any party to verify that the rules that produced a historical PolicyDecision have not been modified.

ruleset_engine.description: The policy engine this ruleset targets. opa: Open Policy Agent (Rego); cedar: AWS Cedar; casbin: Casbin; custom: implementation-specific engine declared in ruleset_engine_ref.

ruleset_engine_version.description: The minimum engine version required to evaluate this ruleset, e.g. '0.68.0' for OPA.

ruleset_uri.description: Optional URI where the ruleset artifact can be fetched. Must match ruleset_hash when fetched.

attestation_level.description: unverified: self-published, no third-party review. self_attested: publisher claims compliance but no independent audit. verified: independently audited by a recognised body (required for AGP Compliance Certification).

certifying_body.description: The body that issued the verified attestation. Required when attestation_level is 'verified'.

effective_from.description: The earliest datetime from which this PolicySet is valid for use in PolicyDecisions.

expires_at.description: If set, PolicyDecisions referencing this PolicySet must be issued before this time.

supersedes.description: The policy_set_id of the previous version this PolicySet supersedes. Allows audit tools to reconstruct the policy history for any task.
